title: The Siege of Vaikuntha
lines: A game for 2 to 4 kings, set in the world of the Mahabharata.
Each king begins with 3 pawns on Rajasuya Yajna (Start) and 1000 Gold.
Travel the outer ring, buy kingdoms, raise Forts and Palaces, and collect rent.
Enter the inner Ludo track through the gates, and capture rival pawns.
Win by bringing all 3 of your pawns to the Vaikuntha Lotus,
or by being the last king left when all others go bankrupt.

title: Beginning a Game
lines: On the opening page, choose 2, 3 or 4 Players.
Press "Begin the Siege" for a new game, or "Continue Saga" to load a saved one.
Everyone plays on the same screen and takes turns.
The player panel shows each king's Gold, Kingdoms, full Sets, Kills and pawns home.
The Chronicle on the right records everything that happens.

title: Taking a Turn
lines: 1. Throw the sticks: click and hold them in the dice box, swing, and let go.
2. Read your score (see the next leaf).
3. The pawns that can move start to pulse. Click one to move it.
4. Deal with the space you land on: buy, pay, draw a card, capture...
5. The turn passes to the next king.
Before throwing you may also BUILD, SELL, or SAVE the game.

title: The Pasa Sticks
lines: Each stick has four long faces marked with 0, 1, 2 or 3 dots.
Add the dots on the two faces that land on top.
If both sticks land blank (0 + 0), the score is 12.
So every throw moves 1 to 6 spaces, or 12.
If no pawn can use the score, the turn passes.

title: Start and the Kingdoms
lines: Pawns move clockwise around the outer ring of 40 spaces.
Passing or landing on Rajasuya Yajna (Start) pays you 200 Gold.
Land on an unowned kingdom: choose to Buy it or Pass.
Land on a rival's kingdom: you must pay its owner rent.
Land on your own kingdom: nothing happens.

title: The Seven Kingdom Sets
lines: Slate: Vidarbha 80, Kekaya 60, Sarasvata 60  (Fort 50)
Pink: Sauvira 120, Karusha 100, Dwarka 100  (Fort 50)
Orange: Kamakhya 160, Bahilra 160, Sourastra 140  (Fort 100)
Green: Virata 220, Kashi 200, Kuru 180  (Fort 100)
Blue: Vanga 280, Shurasena 260, Kushal 240  (Fort 150)
Crimson: Malava 340, Kalinga 320, Anga 300  (Fort 150)
Black: Gandhara 400, Kosala 360  (Fort 200)

title: Rent
lines: Just the kingdom: its base rent.
The full colour set, no buildings: 2 x base rent.
1 Fort: 4 x     2 Forts: 10 x     3 Forts: 20 x
4 Forts: 30 x     Palace: 40 x base rent.
Owning a whole set is the key to great riches.

title: Taxes, Rewards and Fate
lines: Pay the Bank: Vana Daan 60, Yajna Dakshina 200, Rajasva Kara 200, Kurukshetra 150.
Collect from the Bank: Swayamvara 150, Ashvamedha 200, Akshaya Patram 100.
Gandiva: roll again at once.     Agyatavasa: skip your next turn.
Hall of Dice, Dwarka Haven, Kamyaka Forest and Maya Sabha are places of rest.

title: Cards and Gates
lines: Dharma draws a Dharma card: mostly blessings, Gold and tribute.
Adharma draws an Adharma card: mostly losses, but Shakuni's dice let you choose your next score.
The card flies from its deck to the centre. Click it to carry on.
Four gates stand on the ring: Magadha, Panchala, Indraprastha and Gandhara.
End a move on a gate and you may enter the Ludo track.

title: Forts and Palaces
lines: Own every kingdom of a colour set to build on it.
Press BUILD on your turn, before throwing.
Raise up to 4 Forts on a kingdom; a 5th build makes a Palace.
Build evenly: every kingdom in the set must have a Fort before any gets two.
The Bank holds only 32 Forts and 12 Palaces.

title: Selling and Debt
lines: Press SELL at any time. A kingdom sells for 75% of its price,
a building for 50% of its cost. Sell buildings evenly too.
A kingdom cannot be sold while its set still has buildings.
Owe more than you hold? You must sell until you can pay.
If even everything is not enough, you are bankrupt and leave the game.

title: The Ludo Track and Vadh
lines: Through a gate, a pawn joins the Ludo track: 72 spaces for a full lap.
Vadh: end your move on a rival's pawn to capture it.
It returns to Start without the 200 Gold, and you gain 1 Kill.
No capture on Start, on Safe Houses, or in the Home Stretch.
End a move on an arm's tip to leave the track through its gate (the lap is lost).

title: Finishing a Lap
lines: When a pawn completes a lap back to where it entered:
If you qualify, it turns into the Home Stretch.
If not, you gain 200 Gold and choose to loop again or leave by your gate.
To qualify you need at least 1 full colour set and at least 3 Kills.

title: The Home Stretch and Victory
lines: The Home Stretch is 6 spaces leading to the Vaikuntha Lotus.
You must reach the Lotus with an exact score.
Bring all 3 of your pawns to Vaikuntha and you win the siege.
You also win if every other king goes bankrupt.

title: Handy Tools
lines: Magnifier: move it over the board to read; wheel zooms, Esc puts it away.
SAVE and LOAD work between moves. Return goes back to the opening page.
Shakuni and Narada comment on the game. Click them to send them away.
Settings let you mute or change the music volume.

title: Counsel for New Kings
lines: Buy early: Slate and Pink are cheap and quick to complete.
A full set doubles rent, allows building, and opens the road home.
Hunt for Kills: you need 3, so chase rivals on the Ludo track.
Keep some Gold in hand: taxes and Adharma cards strike without warning.
Read the Chronicle: it tells exactly what happened and who paid whom.
